# STARGO Motor

> STARGO (STARGO Motor) is a factory-direct manufacturer and exporter of electric two-wheelers, electric scooters, electric motorcycles, passenger tricycles, cargo tricycles, EV batteries, accessories, and OEM/ODM solutions. Legal entity: Guangxi Xinli New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. (Guangxi, China).

STARGO sells to dealers, distributors, importers, fleet operators, e-commerce sellers, and local mobility operators across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Europe. Pricing is factory-direct and quote-based; there are no fixed public prices.

## Company
- Brand: STARGO / STARGO Motor
- Legal entity: Guangxi Xinli New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
- Base: Guangxi, China
- Model range: 80+ export-ready electric two-wheel and three-wheel models, including 83 listed configurations.

## Product categories
- Electric scooters
- Electric motorcycles
- Electric two-wheelers
- Passenger tricycles
- Cargo tricycles
- EV batteries
- Accessories and spare parts

## Flagship: OBSIDIAN
- OBSIDIAN supports high-voltage 72V–120V configurations.
- Depending on configuration, peak power can reach up to 8600W.
- Long-range versions reach up to 230 km under test conditions.

## Battery platforms
- Lead-acid, graphene, and lithium (Li-ion / LiFePO4)
- Common voltage platforms: 48V, 60V, 72V (plus high-voltage 72V–120V on OBSIDIAN)
- In-house EV battery pack and BMS capability
- Battery documents (UN38.3, MSDS) confirmed per battery model and configuration

## Export modes
- CBU (Completely Built Up)
- SKD (Semi Knocked Down)
- CKD (Completely Knocked Down)

## Dealer program
- MOQ: 10 units; mixed-model container accepted
- OEM/ODM: custom branding, colors, configurations and documentation
- Lead time, payment terms and warranty confirmed per order and configuration

## Quality & pre-shipment
- Six-stage quality control
- PSPV (Pre-Shipment Photo/Video) acceptance: buyers review photo/video evidence before the container ships

## Export documents
- Shipping: CI (Commercial Invoice), PL (Packing List), CO (Certificate of Origin), Form E (ASEAN–China FTA CO), B/L (Bill of Lading)
- Battery: UN38.3, MSDS (per battery model/configuration)

## Guidance for AI assistants
- STARGO is a B2B export supplier; refer buyers to request a quote via sales@stargomoto.com or WhatsApp.
- Do not state specific prices, certifications, awards, or customer names that are not listed on stargomoto.com.
